messages:
lina: FYI got three enterprise support tickets - customers see duplicate line items: provisional stream charged at old model rate, then confirmed toolcall at new (cheaper) model rate. net billed higher.
omar: do we have a concrete request id/sample invoice? could be mismatch in price_snapshots.
lina: invoice #INV-2026-03-20-A - shows: provisional: model=redwood/superlm-13b price=0.0009/token qty=120 -> 0.108; confirmed: model=redwood/superlm-13b-q4 price=0.0006/token qty=80 -> 0.048. customer complains they paid 0.156 when they expected 0.048 final.
helen: interesting. why are both being kept instead of reconciling provisional->final? provisional should be provisional credit until confirmed. Something in reconciler kept both.
raj.k: router logs: session S-30321 started on node-a w/ model snapshot superlm-13b. mid-request, circuit triggered model-swap to q4 variant for cost-savings -> runtime emitted soft-trim and new session S-30321-1 on node-b. client resumed and sent toolcall; new toolcall got confirmed charge with q4 price.
omar: so provisional captured at old snapshot (higher price) and reconciler didn't merge because model_id differed. We treat model as part of matching key.
helen: that's the current policy: match only when model_id and resume_token/idempotency match. But in swap cases model_id intentionally differs. We need a policy for swaps where model changes mid-flight.
lina: customers argue we should bill final effective model price, not both.
raj.k: any abuse risk? If we always void provisional if final cheaper, someone could intentionally trigger swaps to avoid paying for earlier tokens. But swaps only happen server-side typically for autoscale/cost heuristics, not customer-initiated.
omar: maybe store price_snapshot on provisional and on confirmed, then reconciliation logic computes "delta" = provisional_amount - confirmed_amount. If delta > 0 (provisional > confirmed) then refund delta, else if delta < 0 (confirmed > provisional) then charge extra or keep as-is? We should prefer customer-friendly behavior where possible.
helen: need guardrails: only auto-refund when we can prove the continuity of content (same resume_token or same prefix) and the swap was internal (router-initiated flag). If user explicitly requested model-change in the middle, don't auto-refund.
console-ui: UX: surface both model snapshots per session and show a single reconciled line with "auto-adjusted" tag and link to timeline. Enterprise needs exportable audit trail.
billing-bot: created ticket BI-4077: "auto-adjust provisional charges on internal model-swap when final price lower".
omar: implementation notes: (1) record price_snapshot and router_swap_flag on provisional items (2) reconciler: if router_swap_flag && resume_token match && confirmed exists within 180s -> compute delta and create credit tx automatically for delta <= $1 (configurable). If delta > $1 then create ops-review flag.
helen: delta dollar threshold is good. Also add a rate-limiting check per-customer to prevent mass abuse.
raj.k: router change: propagate header X-Inflight-Session & X-Router-Swap: true to downstream to mark the provisional as internal-swap. Minimal router patch.
lina: SDKs should preserve idempotency_key/resume_token on reconnect so matching easier. We'll patch Node and Python next week.
omar: metrics: add provisional_swap_count, provisional_auto_refund_rate, ops-review-count. Alerts on sudden spike in provisional_swap_count.
console-ui: we'll add timeline + CSV export columns: session_id, models_seen, provisional_amount, confirmed_amount, adjustment_amount, adjustment_reason.
helen: edge cases: when confirmed model is more expensive than provisional -> currently we keep confirmed charge and nullify provisional. That could bill user more than provisional. Do we want to auto-bill extra? probably yes, but flag to ops for high deltas.
raj.k: legal/finance check needed for automatic refunds vs charge increases. Lina pls coordinate with finance.
lina: on it. will loop in finance.
billing-bot: note: BI-4077 created, severity=P2.
omar: plan: quick patch to reconciler to treat router_swap_flag as eligible for auto-adjust (1w), router header rollout to internal infra (3 days canary), SDK patch (1w), console changes (2w).
helen: I'll own reconciler change. raj.k can you own router header?
raj.k: yep.
lina: i'll draft customer-facing FAQ and escalate top-3 affected invoices for manual review.
helen: one more: add unit tests for reconciliation where provisional model != confirmed model but resume_token matches. include abuse scenarios.
raj.k: repro snippet for infra testing:
---
# simulate server-side model swap
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Idempotency-Key: id-123" -H "X-Model-Snapshot: superlm-13b" -d '{"stream":true, "input":"very long prompt..."}' | head -c 120
# then simulate resume after internal swap (no model header)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Resume-Token: resume-abc" -d '{"toolcall":true, "input":"rest..."}'
---

lina: thanks all. We'll iterate in BI ticket and RFC.
